mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_product_browse_history ( member_id, spu_id, mch_id, shop_id, last_browse_time, browse_count ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{spuId}, #{mchId}, #{shopId}, #{browseTime}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_browse_time = VALUES(last_browse_time), browse_count = browse_count + 1, update_time = NOW()
